name: dung-tools
description: Dung's reusable Claude Code extensions — project-agnostic workflow roles, shared across projects & machines.

plugins.name: roles
plugins.description: Generic CTO (advisor: research → self-sufficient Plan → independent review) and EM (executor: Plan → Coder/Reviewer loop → branch-per-step) role skills. Project-agnostic; project specifics live in each repo's PROJECT_CONTEXT / PROJECT_STATE.

plugins.name: system-report
plugins.description: Automated daily system health report. /system-report:init scaffolds config + tooling into any repo; /system-report:run collects multi-instance logs, runs a READ-ONLY AI triage (known-issues + watchlist + code correlation) and delivers a severity-ranked digest via webhook + dated file. Project-agnostic; project specifics live in the repo's ops/system-report/config.yml.
